newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury's 3-, 6-mo bills seen at 5.02/5.07 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury's 3-, 6-mo bills seen at 5.02/5.07 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $28.0 billion in three- and six-month bills is expected to produce average rates of 5.02 percent and 5.07 percent, respectively.
The bidding deadline for the auction, which was postponed by a day due to the Veterans Day holiday, is 1300 EST/1800 GMT.
In when-issued trade shortly before the bidding deadline, three-month bill rates were trading at 5.02 percent and six-month rates traded at 5.07 percent.
